posts.title: It's Cold Out Again
posts.description: It's cold out again, and so I'm back to my blog. I hadn't expected to take a break over the warmer months, though I'm glad I had a lively enough summer that documenting random musings took a backseat. posts.title: RSS 4 Noobs (Getting Started)
posts.description: I have a habit of insisting RSS is great and that people should be using it, then making no follow-up effort to explain how that's done or why. This is meant as a clear, actionable guide to getting started with RSS feeds if you're not even sure what they are. Only the fruits, no vegetables. What is RSS?
